goal: Verify that an aircraft acknowledgement of receipt includes the aircraft call sign.
scenarioPreconditions: A message is received by an aircraft and an acknowledgement of receipt is required.
The harness can observe or generate the acknowledgement transmission text.
expectedObservations: The acknowledgement includes the aircraft call sign.
An acknowledgement missing the aircraft call sign is rejected or classified as non-conforming.
notes: This is operational-guidance level, not an authoritative law claim.
It is still suitable as a phraseology/conformance consumer artifact.
